name: 05 - Randomized Traffic
description: Requests whose params use template variables: {{randomWord}} draws a generic English word (misses and fuzzy matches included - that is what real traffic looks like), {{randomPokemon}} draws a species name the index always answers. Both resolve to a fresh word for EVERY dispatched request - in a performance run each worker iteration queries something different. Note the loose assertions: an exact total like the curated searches assert would be meaningless here, which is the point - assertions are per-request choices, editable in the Request tab.
